name.local: ベータ・ベンチャーキャピタル株式会社

check_size.raw: 数千万円 (tens of millions of yen, seed)

strategy.thesis: Kyushu-rooted regional VC built on a '金融の地産地消' (local production and consumption of finance) philosophy: capital sourced from local enterprises and regional banks recycled into next-generation startups and SMEs, with the firm acting as a CFO-like partner from seed through Series A ('First to Last').

summary.en: Fukuoka-based seed-stage VC rooted in Kyushu since 2006 (renamed from DOGAN beta to β Venture Capital in March 2024). Pursues a 'local finance for local communities' model, raising capital from regional LPs and investing in Kyushu/Okinawa/Yamaguchi startups; has run ~4 funds totaling roughly ¥5B and backed ~97 companies.
summary.local: 福岡を拠点に2006年から九州に根ざすシード特化VC。2024年3月にドーガン・ベータからベータ・ベンチャーキャピタルへ社名変更。「金融の地産地消」を掲げ、地域企業・地銀から集めた資金で九州・沖縄・山口のスタートアップに投資。累計約4ファンド・約50億円、投資先約97社。

aka: せとうちスタートアップス

funds.name: SetouchiStartups1号投資事業有限責任組合 (Setouchi VC Fund I)
SetouchiStartups2号投資事業有限責任組合 (Fund II)

strategy.thesis: The Setouchi area's first independent venture fund: supplies pre-seed/seed risk capital to founders based in or originating from the Setouchi (Seto Inland Sea) and wider Chugoku-Shikoku region, aiming to build a regional startup ecosystem with social-contribution and regional-revitalization themes.

application.how_to_apply: Contact via setouchi.vc; entrepreneur must be based in or originate from the Setouchi area

summary.en: Okayama-based VC (organized November 2021) billed as the Setouchi region's first independent venture fund. Fund I closed at ¥100M with ¥3M–¥10M pre-seed/seed checks for founders rooted in the Seto Inland Sea / Chugoku-Shikoku area. Renamed 瀬戸内と (SETOUCHI TO) in April 2025; Fund II formed June 2025.
summary.local: 岡山市を拠点に2021年11月組成、瀬戸内エリア初の独立系ベンチャーファンド。1号ファンドは1億円、プレシード〜シードに300万〜1000万円を投資。2025年4月に「瀬戸内と株式会社」へ社名変更、同年6月に2号ファンドを設立。

funds.name: スパークル1号ファンド (Sparkle Fund I)

size.raw: 約10億円 (final close, target had been ¥3B)

strategy.thesis: Tohoku-focused independent VC built on a '地域発、地域着' (originate in the region, land in the region) concept, even encouraging startups to relocate to Tohoku. Invests in (1) post-seed/early startups that transact with or create new business for regional enterprises and (2) pre-seed/seed deeptech and web3 ventures leveraging local resources.

summary.en: Sendai-based independent VC (company established 2018; current 株式会社 reincorporated August 2022) focused on the Tohoku region. Its Fund I final-closed at roughly ¥1B in 2023 (Tohoku Bank and ~25 LPs) and had backed ~13 companies, targeting both regional-enterprise-linked early startups and pre-seed deeptech/web3 ventures.
summary.local: 仙台市を拠点に東北に特化する独立系VC。「地域発、地域着」を掲げ、1号ファンドは2023年に総額約10億円でファイナルクローズ(東邦銀行など計25者がLP)、約13社に投資。ポストシード〜アーリーの地域連携型と、プレシード〜シードのディープテック・web3を対象。

funds.name: ステージアップファンド投資事業有限責任組合 (Stage-Up Fund / SUF)

strategy.thesis: Tohoku-focused VC and accelerator (part of the MAKOTO group) aiming to create world-class innovation from the Tohoku region. Targets university-origin (大学発) ventures from Tohoku universities and companies solving regional needs, investing mainly at seed and early stage alongside accelerator programs and management consulting.

application.how_to_apply: Contact via mkto-capital.jp; also runs accelerator programs

summary.en: Sendai-based VC and accelerator within the MAKOTO group, established June 2018, focused on creating innovation from the Tohoku region. Its Stage-Up Fund (SUF) raised ¥750M to back Tohoku university-origin ventures and regional-need startups at seed/early stage, with KDDI among LPs.
summary.local: 仙台市を拠点とするMAKOTOグループのVC・アクセラレーター(2018年6月設立)。東北発のイノベーション創出を掲げ、ステージアップファンド(SUF)を7.5億円で組成。東北の大学発ベンチャーや地域課題解決型スタートアップにシード・アーリー中心で投資。KDDIもLPに参画。

aka: ポーラーショートカット

strategy.thesis: Hokkaido-specialized seed VC operating 'in a manner close to a startup studio' — providing capital plus hands-on management/business-development support to founders from incorporation through early seed. Themes include primary-industry (agriculture/fisheries) digitalization, space business, food and medical innovation, Hokkaido-brand D2C, and rural infrastructure solutions.

summary.en: Sapporo-based, Hokkaido-specialized seed VC (company founded April 2020). Its Fund I (formed April 2021) targets up to ¥300M and backs founders from incorporation through early seed, operating studio-style with hands-on support across agri/fisheries digitalization, space, food/medical, Hokkaido D2C, and rural infrastructure.
summary.local: 札幌を拠点とする北海道特化のシードVC(2020年4月設立)。1号ファンド(2021年4月組成)は最大3億円規模で、創業からシード初期のスタートアップを対象に、スタートアップスタジオに近い形でハンズオン支援。一次産業DX・宇宙・食/医療・北海道ブランドD2C・地方インフラ等が投資テーマ。

name.local: 株式会社Central Japan Innovation Capital

funds.name: 東海研究開発1号投資事業有限責任組合 (Tokai R&D Fund I)

strategy.thesis: University-affiliated deeptech VC under the Tokai National Higher Education and Research System (Nagoya & Gifu Universities). Targets 'Deep Tech × BtoB' seed/early-stage startups — mobility, materials & semiconductors, AI/robotics, life sciences, manufacturing, agriculture — solving social problems through technology, including international deals.

summary.en: Nagoya-based deeptech VC founded November 2024 as a sub-subsidiary of the Tokai National Higher Education and Research System (Nagoya & Gifu Universities). Its Fund I first-closed at ¥3.3B (anchors: Aichi Prefecture, Nagoya City, MUFG Bank, Aichi Bank) targeting ¥5–10B, investing in seed/early Deep Tech × BtoB startups in mobility, materials, AI/robotics and life sciences.
summary.local: 名古屋を拠点に2024年11月設立、東海国立大学機構(名古屋大学・岐阜大学)傘下のディープテックVC。1号ファンドは33億円でファーストクローズ(愛知県・名古屋市・三菱UFJ銀行・愛知銀行がアンカーLP)、最大50〜100億円を目標。モビリティ・素材・半導体・AIロボティクス・ライフサイエンス等のシード/アーリーのディープテックに投資。

name.local: OIST-ライフタイムベンチャーズ・ファンド

strategy.thesis: A deep-tech fund managed by Lifetime Ventures in collaboration with the Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST), backed by Incubate Fund. Invests pre-seed/seed in science-based startups — healthtech, the future of work, sustainable living, and the 'blue economy' — helping OIST and other technical/domain experts turn research into companies.

application.how_to_apply: Via OIST innovation/startup support channels and Lifetime Ventures

summary.en: An Okinawa-based deep-tech fund launched in 2022 by Lifetime Ventures with the Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST), backed by Incubate Fund. Targets ¥5B (US$40M) and invests pre-seed/seed in science-based startups (healthtech, future of work, sustainable living, blue economy) from OIST, Japan, and globally.
summary.local: 沖縄を拠点に2022年に組成された、ライフタイムベンチャーズが沖縄科学技術大学院大学(OIST)と共同運営しインキュベイトファンドが支援するディープテック・ファンド。総額50億円(US$40M)を目標に、OISTや国内外のサイエンス系スタートアップにプレシード〜シードで投資。

summary.en: Suita/Osaka-based VC wholly owned by The University of Osaka (company established December 2014). Fund I (2015) was ¥12.51B and Fund II (January 2021) was ¥10.65B, investing seed/early in deeptech startups commercializing Osaka University and other national-university research.

funds.name: ハック大阪投資事業有限責任組合 (Hack Osaka Fund)

check_size.raw: 数千万〜数億円 (tens of millions to hundreds of millions of yen)

strategy.thesis: Osaka/Kansai-region independent VC connecting 'Osaka technology' with Silicon Valley/global knowledge; positions itself as a regional lead VC investing from seed through later stage, with IoT and smart-X themes across housing, automobiles and medical.

application.how_to_apply: Contact via hack-ventures.com; also runs OSAP and Wakayama acceleration screening

summary.en: Osaka-based independent VC (established May 2013) acting as a lead VC for the Kansai region. Its Hack Osaka Fund organized ~¥4.5B (2014) and first-closed at ¥4.8B in 2015 (target ¥10B), with LPs including Osaka City and major banks; invests seed-to-late with IoT/smart-X themes. Still active, also running Osaka/Wakayama acceleration screening.
summary.local: 大阪を拠点とする独立系VC(2013年5月設立)で関西圏のリードVC。ハック大阪ファンドを2014年に約45億円で組成、2015年に48億円でファーストクローズ(目標100億円)。LPに大阪市やメガバンク等。シードから後期まで、住宅・自動車・医療のIoT/スマート化領域に投資。OSAP・和歌山アクセラレーションの審査も実施。
